beats.say: What if every human on Earth disappeared… right now?
Cars crash with no one driving.
Phones keep ringing in empty streets.
Within hours, power plants shut down.
Every city on Earth goes dark.
Zoo animals break out and take over the streets.
Year ten: trees burst through the roads.
Year one hundred: skyscrapers crash into the jungle.
Year ten thousand: cities are just green hills.
All that's left of us… the pyramids.
